== Summary ==
Unscaled original-pixel comparison of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]] paper layouts. Left: original image xref38/mask37 in [[:File:Errata-Sheet-2021-Spring-original.pdf]], page 2. Right: original image xref90/mask89 in [[:File:Virtual-Set-9-October-2023.pdf]], page 6. The older partial prints unnumbered E; the later partial prints E1. The frame and game-text line breaks differ, including the OR after the first function. Card pixels remain unchanged; white comparison canvas and labels added. Lucasfilm Ltd.; originals published by the Players Committee.
